I changed the scene route and the `urls.decisionPlayground()` helper in two files:
- `products/ml_inference/manifest.tsx`
- `frontend/src/products.tsx`, which holds the same two entries as the manifest. I edited it by hand rather than regenerating it.

The Storybook story builds its page URL from `urls.decisionPlayground()`, so it follows the new address. I found no other hardcoded links to the old path, and I didn't add a redirect from the old address, so `/ml-inference/decisions` no longer resolves.
